universal-healthcare: The government should provide universal healthcare.
raise-minimum-wage: The minimum wage should be raised substantially.
markets-allocate-better: Free markets allocate resources better than governments do.
public-ownership: Major industries like energy, rail and utilities should be publicly owned.
tax-the-wealthy: Taxes on the wealthy should be significantly higher.
unions-good: Labor unions are good for workers and for society.
property-fundamental: Private property is a fundamental right that should be very hard to override.
regulate-corporations: Corporations should be more tightly regulated.
cut-welfare: Welfare programs create dependency and should be cut.
worker-ownership: Workers should collectively own the businesses they work in.
surveillance-ok: Government surveillance is acceptable if it prevents terrorism.
legalize-drugs: Recreational drugs should be legal for adults.
restrict-hate-speech: Hate speech should be legally restricted.
strong-leader: A strong leader who can bypass political gridlock would benefit the country.
state-harmful: The state itself is unnecessary and harmful.
limit-guns: Gun ownership should be strictly limited.
empower-police-military: The police and military need more funding and authority.
legalize-sex-work: Sex work between consenting adults should be legal.
decide-locally: Decisions should be made as locally as possible rather than by national government.
rehabilitation: Prisons should focus on rehabilitation rather than punishment.
traditional-family: Traditional family structures are the foundation of a healthy society.
abortion-legal: Abortion should be legal in most cases.
more-religion-public: Religion should play a larger role in public life.
correct-racial-injustice: Society should actively work to correct historical racial injustices.
gender-social-construct: Gender is primarily a social construct.
preserve-national-culture: Preserving national culture and traditions is important.
gradual-change: Social change should be gradual and respect established institutions.
empower-international-orgs: International organizations like the UN should have more power.
free-trade: Free trade benefits everyone in the long run.
nation-first: My country should put its own interests ahead of global cooperation.
humanitarian-intervention: Military intervention abroad is sometimes necessary to protect human rights.
open-borders: National borders should eventually be open.
limit-growth: Economic growth should be limited to protect the environment.
drastic-climate-action: Climate change requires drastic government action.
tech-solves-problems: Technological progress will solve most of humanity's problems.
revolution-justified: Revolution is sometimes justified to achieve political change.
experts-over-public: Experts should have more say in policy than the general public.
central-planning: A centrally planned economy can work better than a market economy.
socialized-markets: Markets are acceptable as long as businesses are owned by their workers or the public.
land-value-tax: A tax on the value of land should replace most other taxes.
tax-inheritance: Large inheritances should be heavily taxed.
basic-income: Every adult should receive an unconditional basic income from the state.
tariffs-protect-industry: Tariffs should protect domestic industry from foreign competition.
state-directs-investment: The state should direct investment toward strategic industries.
widespread-small-property: Property should be spread widely among small owners rather than concentrated in corporations or the state.
abolish-money-wages: Money and wage labor should eventually be abolished.
abolish-central-banks: Central banks should be abolished and money left to the market.
corporatist-bargaining: Employers and workers should be organized into state-recognized bodies that set wages and prices together.
one-party-rule: A single party guided by the correct ideology should lead the state.
monarchy-legitimate: A hereditary monarch can be a legitimate and good head of state.
democracy-best: Democracy is the best form of government, even when voters choose badly.
direct-votes: Citizens should vote directly on major laws rather than leaving them to representatives.
workers-councils: Workers' councils, not parliaments, should be the basis of political power.
right-to-secede: Regions should have the right to secede from the country.
natural-rulers: Some people are naturally better suited to rule than others.
war-builds-character: War can strengthen a nation's character.
separate-church-state: Religion and the state should be strictly separated.
laws-from-scripture: Laws should be based on religious scripture.
private-courts-defense: Courts, policing and defense could be provided by private companies.
military-superiority: My country should maintain military superiority over its rivals.
ethnic-nation: A nation should be made up mainly of one ethnic group.
class-struggle-history: Class conflict is the main driving force of history.
equal-outcomes: Society should aim for equality of outcomes, not only of opportunity.
indigenous-land-authority: Indigenous peoples should have authority over their traditional lands.
colonial-reparations: Former colonial powers owe reparations to the nations they colonized.
civilizational-union: Nations that share a religion or civilization should unite politically.
self-interest-moral: Pursuing your own self-interest is morally good.
duties-before-rights: Citizens' duties to their community come before their individual rights.
nature-intrinsic-value: Nature has value in itself, apart from its usefulness to humans.
limit-population: Population growth should be actively limited.
industrial-civilization-disaster: Industrial civilization has been a disaster for humanity.
accelerate-technology: Society should speed up technological change even if it disrupts existing institutions.
human-enhancement: People should be free to enhance their bodies and minds with technology.
algorithmic-government: AI and algorithms should take over more government decision-making.
unbreakable-encryption: People should be able to use encryption the government cannot break.
restore-past-order: Restoring a lost social order matters more than pursuing progress.
results-over-ideology: Policies should be judged by their results, not by whether they fit an ideology.
direct-action: Political change should come through direct action rather than through elections and parliaments.
means-match-ends: The methods used to change society should reflect the society one wants to create.
return-to-foraging: Humanity would be better off returning to a hunter-gatherer way of life.
abolish-division-of-labor: The division of labor should be abolished.
distribute-by-need: Goods should ultimately be distributed according to each person's needs rather than their work or wealth.
production-for-use: Goods and services should be produced to meet people's needs rather than to make a profit.
profit-exploitation: Profit made from owning businesses comes from exploiting the workers who produce it.
dictatorship-of-proletariat: After a revolution, the working class should hold dictatorial power over the former ruling classes until classes disappear.
collective-farming: Agricultural land should be farmed collectively rather than by individual farmers.
capitalism-causes-war: Capitalism inevitably leads to imperialism and wars between the great powers.
taxation-theft: Taxation is a form of theft or forced labor.
harm-principle: The state may restrict what adults do only to prevent harm to others.
individual-rights-only: Rights belong to individuals, not to groups.
conscription: The government should be able to conscript citizens into military service.
exit-over-voice: The freedom to leave a country is a more important check on government than the right to vote.
state-as-business: Governments should be run like businesses, with citizens treated as customers who can leave.
media-academia-power: Universities and the news media together hold more real political power than elected officials.
hereditarian-race: Average differences in ability between racial groups are largely genetic.
organic-representation: Citizens should be represented through families, local communities and trade bodies rather than through political parties.
total-state: The state should direct every area of life, including culture, education and the economy.
national-rebirth: The nation needs a radical rebirth to overcome a period of decadence.
territorial-expansion: A strong nation should expand its territory and influence abroad.
personal-loyalty-rule: Political authority should rest on personal oaths of loyalty between lords and their followers.
bound-labor: Those who farm the land should be legally bound to it and owe labor to its lord.
universal-morality: There are universal moral truths, knowable by reason, that hold across all cultures.
single-common-good: Politics should aim at one common good worked out by reason, rather than balancing the competing interests of different groups.
jewish-state-israel: The Jewish people have a right to a state of their own in the Land of Israel.
diaspora-return-right: Members of a nation's diaspora should have the right to return to its homeland and become citizens.
revive-national-language: A national language that has fallen out of everyday use should be revived as the language of the state.
workplace-democracy: Workers and the public should have a democratic vote in how large companies are run.
school-vouchers: Parents should receive public vouchers to spend on any school they choose.
avoid-deficit-stimulus: Governments should avoid running large budget deficits to stimulate the economy.
economic-freedom: Political freedom cannot last without economic freedom.
rule-by-example: Government should rely on the moral example of its rulers more than on laws and punishments.
national-self-determination: Every nation has the right to govern itself in its own state.
force-without-un: My country should be willing to use force abroad without approval from the UN Security Council.
reason-over-faith: Reason, not faith or emotion, should be the only guide to knowledge and action.
welfare-for-citizens: Welfare benefits should be reserved for citizens rather than extended to immigrants.
work-for-welfare: People who are able to work should be required to do so in order to receive welfare benefits.
class-collaboration: Employers and workers should cooperate as partners rather than struggle as opposed classes.
sacrifice-heritage: Museums, libraries and other inherited cultural institutions should be sacrificed if they hold back new creation.
dominated-front: Countries that see themselves as dominated by the leading Western powers should form a common front against them.
workers-nation: The working class should organize along national lines rather than as an international class.
positive-liberty: Freedom requires that people have the material means to act on it, not only the absence of interference.
distinct-gender-roles: Law should reflect distinct roles for men and women in public life.
ban-interest: Lending money at interest should be prohibited by law.
racial-segregation-law: The law should classify people by race and keep the races separate in where they live, study and use public facilities.
state-class-instrument: The state is essentially a tool by which the ruling class dominates the others.
expand-fossil-fuels: Domestic oil, gas and coal production should be expanded.
assimilate-immigrants: Immigrants should be expected to give up their original culture and assimilate into the national culture.
elite-replacement: Elites are deliberately promoting mass immigration to replace or weaken the native population.
proportional-representation: Legislative seats should be allocated to parties in proportion to the votes they receive.
national-mission: My country has a special mission to spread its form of government to other peoples.
patriarchy-structural: Society is organized so as to systematically advantage men over women.
political-elite-corrupt: Political elites are corrupt and out of touch with ordinary people.
heritable-defect-limits: The state should discourage or prevent people with heritable defects from having children.
security-forces-accountable: Governments should be held legally accountable for past killings and abuses committed by their security forces.
night-watchman-state: Government should be limited to defending the country, enforcing justice and protecting property.
discourage-race-mixing: Marriage and having children across racial lines should be discouraged.
equal-moral-worth: All people are of equal moral worth and should have equal rights before the law.
socialism-one-country: Socialism cannot be lasting in one country alone; it requires revolution in other countries too.
settler-state-colonial: A state created by settlement from abroad that displaced the existing population is a colonial project.
uniform-civil-code: All citizens should be governed by the same civil laws regardless of their religion.
restrict-conversion: Religious conversion should be restricted by law.
ban-cattle-slaughter: The slaughter of cattle should be banned by law.
no-religion-state-schools: State schools should not provide religious instruction.
state-strengthens-encirclement: A socialist state should grow stronger, not wither away, for as long as it is surrounded by hostile states.
consent-of-governed: Political authority is legitimate only if it rests on the consent of the governed.
trade-surplus: A country should aim to export more than it imports.
population-transfer: A government may require or pressure members of a minority seen as hostile to leave the country.
initiating-force-wrong: It is always wrong to initiate force against another person or their property, whatever the goal.
no-neutral-knowledge: No knowledge is neutral: what a society counts as true reflects who holds power in it.
competition-drives-progress: Competition and struggle, between individuals and between peoples, are the main engine of human progress.
ban-extremist-parties: A government may outlaw political parties that seek to abolish its constitutional order.
freedom-as-non-domination: A person is not free if someone else has the power to interfere in their life arbitrarily, even if that power is never used.
separated-powers: Political power should be divided among separate bodies that check one another.
vanguard-party: The working class will not reach revolutionary politics on its own; it needs a disciplined party of committed revolutionaries to lead it.
priority-to-poor: Laws and institutions should give first priority to the needs of the poor.
right-to-buy-council-homes: Council tenants should have a legal right to buy their homes.
restrict-strikes-picketing: The law should restrict strikes and picketing, for example by requiring secret ballots.
population-causes-poverty: Population growth, not social institutions, is the main cause of lasting poverty.
diversity-weakens-cohesion: Ethnic and racial diversity makes a society less cohesive and more prone to conflict.
offices-by-lottery: Public offices should be filled by lottery among citizens rather than by election.
emergency-suspend-protections: In a national emergency, a government may suspend ordinary legal protections to defeat its internal enemies.
price-controls-essentials: Governments should fix maximum prices for essential foods in times of scarcity.
party-controls-media: News media and online information should be controlled by the government or ruling party.
party-commands-army: The armed forces should be commanded by the ruling party rather than by the state.
long-naturalization-wait: Immigrants should have to live in a country for many years before they can become citizens.
representatives-worker-pay: Elected representatives should be paid no more than an average worker.
party-discipline-binding: Members of a political party should be bound to carry out its decisions once they have been debated and adopted.
pool-sovereignty: Nations should pool part of their sovereignty in a supranational union such as the European Union.
head-commands-forces: The head of state, not the legislature, should command the armed forces and choose the government's ministers.
church-by-bishops: The national church should be governed by bishops rather than by congregations or elected assemblies.
clerical-rule: Senior religious scholars should hold the highest political authority.
defeat-own-government-war: In a war between rival great powers, working people should work for their own government's defeat rather than support it.
censor-art-for-virtue: Art, poetry and stories should be censored if they harm citizens' moral character.
unlimited-reelection: A president should be allowed to stand for re-election without limit.
recall-officials: Voters should be able to remove elected officials from office before their term ends.
end-foreign-alliances: My country should end its permanent military alliances and bring its troops home from abroad.
abolish-rental-housing: No one should be allowed to rent out housing; every family should own the home it lives in.
people-in-arms: A professional army should be replaced by an armed citizenry.
rural-life-healthier: Rural life is morally healthier than life in cities.
reunify-divided-nation: A nation divided between states by a border drawn by an outside power should be reunified as one state.
educated-out-of-touch: University-educated people tend to be out of touch with the realities of ordinary life.
cultures-equal-different: No culture or civilization is higher or lower than another; they are only different.
death-penalty: The state should be able to execute people convicted of the gravest crimes, such as terrorism.
sex-ed-in-schools: School curricula should include sex education and gender equality.
creationism-in-schools: Public schools should teach creationism or intelligent design alongside evolution.
restrict-pornography: Pornography should be restricted by law.
citizenship-by-descent: Citizenship should pass by descent from citizen parents rather than by birth on the territory.
minority-language-support: Governments should support minority languages in schools, public services and elections.
religious-exemptions: Members of religious minorities should be exempt from general laws that burden their religious practice.
encourage-eccentricity: Social pressure to conform to custom harms human development as much as the law does, and eccentric ways of living should be encouraged.
sovereign-debt-cancellation: The foreign debts of poor countries should be cancelled rather than repaid.
independence-needs-economic-change: Political independence means little unless the economic and property system is also transformed.
constituent-assembly: The constitution should be rewritten by a democratically elected constituent assembly.
restrict-freedoms-for-growth: A country may restrict political freedoms for a time to secure rapid economic development.
rich-countries-aid-poor: Wealthy countries have a duty to give substantial aid to the world's poor, wherever those people live.
independent-nuclear-deterrent: My country should maintain its own independent nuclear weapons rather than rely on an ally's protection.
direct-election-head-of-state: The head of state should be elected directly by the people rather than by parliament or an electoral college.
central-bank-independence: Central banks should be independent of elected governments and aim mainly at stable prices.
no-land-for-peace: A country should not give up land it claims as its historic homeland in exchange for peace agreements.
property-serves-common-good: Private property is justified only so far as it serves the common good.
soviet-state-capitalist: The Soviet Union was a state-capitalist society, not a socialist one.
precautionary-principle: Governments should act on environmental risks even before there is scientific certainty that harm will occur.
collective-defense: An armed attack on one allied country should be treated as an attack on all of them.
annexed-territory-occupation: A territory annexed without the consent of its people remains under unlawful occupation.
subordinate-church-to-state: The state should curb the power and property of religious institutions and place the clergy under civil authority.
nonpartisan-head-of-state: A head of state should stand above party politics as a symbol of national unity.
force-to-prevent-secession: A country may use military force to prevent a region from separating from it.
region-keeps-system: A region could join a larger state while keeping its own economic and legal system and a high degree of autonomy.
sacred-ruler: The head of state should be regarded as sacred and of divine descent.
flat-income-tax: Income tax rates should be flat, charging everyone the same percentage rather than rising with income.
character-from-environment: A person's character is formed mainly by upbringing and circumstances rather than by innate nature.
sovereign-above-law: The ruler should not be bound by the laws that he or his predecessors made.
space-expansion: Expanding humanity into space should be a central goal of civilization.
mixed-constitution: The best constitution mixes rule by the few and rule by the many rather than giving power to either alone.
leader-cult: A national leader may be honoured in public life through portraits, statues and mass praise as the embodiment of the nation.
equal-parenting: Courts should presume that children of separated parents spend equal time with each parent.
class-struggle-under-socialism: Class struggle continues under socialism, and party leaders may themselves restore capitalism.
land-redistribution: Large landed estates should be taken from their owners and given to the people who farm the land.
refugee-return: Refugees who fled or were expelled from a conflict should be allowed to return to the homes they left, and their descendants too.
co-ethnic-territorial-claim: A state may claim territory outside its borders because people of its nationality live there.
apostasy-punishable: Leaving one's religion should be punishable by law.
women-must-cover: The law should require women to cover themselves fully in public.
common-currency: A single currency shared by several countries is better than separate national currencies.
kin-peoples-union: Peoples who share a language family and ancestry should work toward political unity across existing borders.
national-cultural-autonomy: A national minority should have its own self-governing cultural institutions and schools within the state, rather than a state of its own.
rights-where-you-live: A persecuted minority should fight for equal rights in the countries where it lives rather than emigrate to found a homeland elsewhere.
material-conditions-drive-history: Social and political change is driven mainly by changes in how society produces and exchanges goods, not by ideas or moral insight.
ban-cartels: The state should prohibit cartels and break up concentrations of economic power in order to protect competition.
no-bailouts: Governments should not bail out failing banks or firms with public money.
courts-bound-by-majority: A liberal democracy's courts and institutions should not constrain what a national majority has chosen.
gender-parity-bodies: Public bodies should be required to have equal or near-equal representation of women and men.
economic-self-sufficiency: A country and its colonies should form a self-sufficient economic bloc shut off from outside trade.
trade-labor-env-standards: International trade agreements should include binding labor and environmental standards.
moral-incentives: Material incentives should be replaced as the main spur to work by moral incentives and a sense of social duty.
armed-group-creates-revolution: A small armed group can create the conditions for revolution rather than waiting for them to appear.
abolish-hereditary-privilege: Hereditary titles and privileges should be abolished.
history-own-civilization: School history should be taught with the student's own nation or civilization at its centre.
civilizing-tutelage: More advanced societies may rightly rule less advanced ones for a time in order to bring them improvement.
patriotic-education: Schools should teach pupils loyalty and pride toward the nation, its flag and its anthem.
end-racial-preferences: Racial preferences in college admissions and hiring should be abolished.
public-money-creation: New money should be created by a public body rather than by private banks lending.
capitalism-adapts: Capitalism can adapt to its crises and avoid a general collapse.
former-empire-influence: A country should cultivate political and cultural influence in regions once ruled by its predecessor empire.
delink-world-market: Poor countries should break their economic ties with rich countries rather than seek integration into the world market.
labor-aristocracy: Workers in rich countries are mostly not exploited, and share in the profits that rich countries extract from poor ones.
freedom-to-discriminate: Private owners should be free to refuse to associate with, hire or serve anyone on any grounds, even where this means discrimination.
entrenched-bill-of-rights: A written bill of rights that ordinary majorities cannot easily amend should limit what government may do.
colonial-treaties-void: Colonial-era treaties that divided a people without consulting it have no binding force today.
elective-rulers: Rulers should be chosen by election among the political nation rather than inherit the throne.
minority-veto: A decision should not bind a dissenting minority, even a single member, without its consent.
resist-lawless-ruler: Subjects may lawfully resist or remove a ruler who breaks the constitutional laws and the trust placed in him.
parliament-supreme: Parliament, not the monarch, should be the supreme lawmaking authority.
animal-suffering-matters: Animals are sentient beings whose suffering matters morally.
animal-use-humane: Animals may be kept and used for food or research, provided their suffering is kept to a minimum.
noblesse-oblige: The wealthy and privileged have a duty to look after those less fortunate than themselves.
withdraw-from-politics: A good life is best lived withdrawn from public affairs rather than taking part in politics.
mass-culture-pacifies: Mass culture and the media serve to pacify people and reproduce the existing social order.
ruling-class-consent: The ruling class maintains power mainly by winning the consent of the governed through culture and institutions, not only by force.
world-economy-extracts-surplus: Poor countries stay poor because the world economy is structured to transfer their surplus to richer countries.
native-born-offices: Public offices should be reserved for native-born citizens.
party-own-road: Each country's communist or socialist party should choose its own road to socialism without direction from another country's party.
self-reliance-over-aid: A poor country should rely on its own resources for development rather than on foreign aid, loans or investment.
return-lost-territory: A country should demand the return of territory it lost to a neighbour in a past war.
indigenous-political-leadership: The descendants of a country's pre-colonial peoples should hold political leadership over the descendants of settlers.
antifascism-founding-value: Anti-fascism should be regarded as a founding value of a democratic constitution.
totalitarianisms-equivalent: Fascism and communism should be condemned together as equivalent forms of totalitarianism.
slavery-not-civil-war-cause: Slavery was not the main cause of the American Civil War.
preserve-contested-monuments: Public monuments and flags honoring figures from a country's past should be preserved even when those figures are now widely condemned.
male-disadvantage-attention: Boys and men facing disadvantage in education, health and suicide deserve the same public attention and programmes as girls and women.
domestic-violence-symmetry: Domestic violence by women against men is as serious as violence by men against women and should receive equal services and protection.
institutions-fit-civilization: Western political institutions do not suit every civilization, which may develop its own forms of government.
military-guardian-role: The armed forces should play a political role as guardians of order and the constitution.
paid-care-work: Unpaid domestic and care work should be recognised and paid as labour.
filial-duty: Adult children owe their parents lifelong respect, care and support.
office-by-exam: Government posts should be filled by competitive examination of learning and ability rather than by election or patronage.
foreign-takeover-block: Governments should block foreign companies from buying firms in strategic industries.
no-fault-divorce: Adults should be free to end a marriage without having to prove fault.
recallable-delegates: Elected leaders should be bound by the decisions of those who chose them and be removable at any time.
individual-pension-accounts: Pensions should be paid from individual savings accounts managed by private companies rather than from a state pay-as-you-go system.
land-use-tenure: Land should belong to the community or the nation, with individuals holding it only for as long as they use it.
budget-needs-parliament: A government should need an elected parliament's approval of its budget before it may spend.
single-official-language: One language should be the sole common language of the state, schooling and public life, even where this restricts the use of other languages.
foreign-land-ownership: Foreigners should not be allowed to own land in the country.
disparate-impact-discrimination: A policy that produces unequal outcomes between racial groups should be treated as discriminatory, whatever its intent.
consumerism-harmful: The pursuit of ever more possessions and status goods does more harm than good to people and society.
arm-foreign-insurgents: My country should arm and fund insurgents fighting governments it considers hostile.
intervene-in-bloc: A great power may send troops into an allied country without its government's consent to stop it leaving the alliance or abandoning its political system.
corporate-influence: Corporations have too much influence over government through lobbying and campaign money.
restrict-foreign-funding: Governments should be able to restrict foreign funding of NGOs, media and universities to protect national sovereignty.
pronatalist-incentives: The state should give families financial incentives to have more children, rather than rely on immigration to offset population decline.
residents-only-property: Local authorities should be able to limit purchases of homes and land in their area to people who live there.
job-guarantee: Governments should guarantee a job to everyone willing to work, acting as employer of last resort.
democratic-peace: Democracies rarely go to war with one another, so spreading democracy makes the world more peaceful.
no-duty-to-obey: People have no general moral duty to obey the law merely because it is the law.
non-intervention: No state or group of states has the right to intervene in the internal affairs of another, for any reason.
industrial-unions: Workers should be organized in unions by industry rather than by craft.
minority-conspiracy: A particular ethnic or religious minority is secretly conspiring against the nation.
abolish-legal-marriage: Marriage should not be a legal institution that confers state benefits and property rights.
public-access-to-information: Everyone should have a legal right of access to government information.
local-production: Food and goods should mainly be produced and bought close to where they are consumed.
informal-organisation: Political struggle should be organized in small informal groups of people who trust one another, rather than in permanent parties, unions or federations.
national-law-over-international: A country's own constitution and courts should take precedence over international law and international courts.
religious-nation: The national community should be defined by a shared religion.
deference-to-leading-power: Foreign states should show deference to a leading power through ritual submission and tribute in return for recognition and trade.
regional-revenue-retention: Revenue raised in a region should mostly be spent in that region rather than shared with other regions.
personal-possessions-private: Personal belongings should remain private while the means of production are held in common.
defeat-communism: Communism should be defeated rather than coexisted with.
mixed-public-service-providers: Public services should be delivered by a mix of public, private and independent providers within a publicly funded system.
religion-illusion: Religion is an illusion that consoles people for real suffering and will fade once their material conditions improve.
capitalism-progressive: Capitalism has been a historically progressive force that created the material basis for a better society.
women-equality-needs-economic-change: Women's equality cannot be fully achieved without transforming the economic system.
socialized-care: Housework and childcare should be provided as public services rather than done privately within families.
purge-loanwords: Words borrowed from foreign languages should be purged from the national language.
treaties-binding: Treaties between a government and a nation within its borders should remain binding until both parties agree to change them.
cooperative-communities: Society should be reorganised into small self-governing cooperative communities that hold their property in common.
majority-settlement: The majority ethnic group should be encouraged to settle in regions where minorities are the majority.
neither-capitalism-nor-communism: Neither capitalism nor communism offers a sound basis for society; a third course is needed.
historical-land-claim: A people's historical or religious tie to a land gives it a stronger claim than the claims of other peoples now living there.
holocaust-denial: The Holocaust did not happen as historians describe it.
criminalize-homosexuality: Sexual relations between adults of the same sex should be a criminal offence.
suppress-opposition: Political opposition and independent organisations should be suppressed to preserve order.
punish-blasphemy: The civil government may punish public blasphemy and the open practice of false religion.
colonies-serve-metropole: A country's overseas territories should be governed for the economic benefit of the ruling country.
defensive-jihad-duty: When non-Muslim forces invade a Muslim land, armed resistance becomes an obligation on every Muslim.
unreligious-rulers-fought: Rulers who do not govern by religious law may be declared illegitimate and removed by force.
participatory-democracy: Ordinary people should take part directly in the decisions that shape their lives, in workplaces, communities and universities, rather than leaving them to distant officials.
intersecting-oppressions: Racism, sexism and class oppression overlap and cannot be addressed one at a time.
gender-identity-recognition: Transgender people should be legally recognised and protected according to their gender identity.
assisted-dying: Medical professionals should be allowed to help terminally ill adults end their lives.
left-right-obsolete: The division of politics into left and right is outdated, and the best ideas of each should be combined.
alienated-labor: Work under capitalism alienates people from their own creative activity.
islam-incompatible: Islam is incompatible with the culture and values of Western countries.
divine-source-of-authority: Political authority ultimately comes from God rather than from the people.
religious-dress-in-state: Public officials and state-school students should not wear religious dress in state institutions.
ban-nda-harassment: Employers should not be able to use nondisclosure agreements or mandatory arbitration to keep sexual harassment complaints out of court.
social-market-economy: A market economy should be combined with social protection and fair competition rules, rather than left to laissez-faire or run by the state.
abolish-armed-forces: Countries should abolish their armed forces.
rich-first: Some people and regions may be allowed to grow rich first so that others can follow step by step.
stay-neutral-between-blocs: My country should stay out of the military blocs of rival great powers.
dynastic-succession: The leader of a state may be succeeded in office by his or her child.
interest-free-mutual-credit: Credit should be issued at cost by banks owned by their users rather than by profit-making banks.
refuse-lender-austerity: Governments should refuse austerity conditions imposed by international lenders such as the IMF.
property-franchise: The right to vote should be limited to those who own property or pay a minimum amount of tax.
domination-women-nature: The domination of women and the domination of nature are connected and should be ended together.
reification: Under capitalism, relations between people take the form of relations between things, so that economic forces seem to rule human beings.
press-owned-by-wealth: Freedom of the press and of assembly mean little while the rich own the presses and the meeting halls.
promulgated-standing-laws: Rulers should govern only through publicly announced standing laws applied by known judges, not by decrees made case by case.
racial-franchise: The right to vote and hold office should be limited to members of one racial or ethnic group.
online-participation: Citizens should be able to take part in political deliberation and decisions over the internet.
open-government-data: Government decision-making records and citizen proposals should be published openly so the public can trace how each was handled.
interfaith-marriage-restriction: The law should restrict marriage between members of different religions.
boycott-minority-shops: Consumers should deliberately avoid shops owned by members of a particular religious minority.
citizens-assembly: Randomly selected groups of citizens should be convened to deliberate on, and help decide, major public questions.
reinterpret-religion: Religious law and doctrine should be reinterpreted for modern conditions rather than followed as medieval authorities fixed them.
wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty: Great concentrations of wealth endanger a free society.
open-lgbt-military-service: Gay and lesbian people should be allowed to serve openly in the armed forces.
state-promotes-atheism: The state should actively promote atheism through its schools and public education.
abolish-police-prisons: Police and prisons should be abolished and replaced with other ways of providing safety.
power-sharing-divided-societies: In a deeply divided society, major communities should share executive power rather than be governed by simple majority rule.
charity-over-state-aid: Private charities and local communities help the poor better than government programs do.
